courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：已知良品、局部對位與混合介面。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Known-good die, local overlay and hybrid interfaces. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 晶圓對晶圓混合接合
related.why: 介電質接合與銅重疊的證據可轉移
related.whyEn: Evidence for dielectric bonding and Cu overlap transfers
related.transfer: 介電質接合與銅重疊的證據可轉移
related.transferEn: Evidence for dielectric bonding and Cu overlap transfers
related.difference: 晶粒對晶圓增加切割污染、拾取及逐顆對位，不能照搬全片接合良率
related.differenceEn: D2W adds singulation contamination, pickup and per-die overlay beyond W2W
practice: 以「已知良品置信度」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「測試覆蓋率與逃逸率決定選片可信度，通過並非零缺陷。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「比較前測、接合後測與失效定位。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use known-good-die confidence to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Test coverage and escapes determine selection confidence; passing is not defect-free.
Using "Compare pre-bond, post-bond and localization data.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 晶粒拾取與精密放置
related.why: 取放座標、旋轉和表面保護直接傳入接合
related.whyEn: Pickup coordinates, rotation and surface protection feed directly into bonding
related.transfer: 取放座標、旋轉和表面保護直接傳入接合
related.transferEn: Pickup coordinates, rotation and surface protection feed directly into bonding
related.difference: 放置精度尚不等於退火後電接點重疊
related.differenceEn: Placement precision is not post-anneal electrical overlay
practice: 以「誤差分解」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「拾取、相機、平台與熱漂移的誤差須分解系統項和隨機項。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「作重複放置和時間序列控制圖。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use overlay decomposition to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Separate systematic and random pickup, camera, stage and thermal errors.
Using "Use repeat placements and time-series control charts.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.
